2019.rateExcludedReason: It is a medical school (Albert Einstein College of Medicine). IPEDS gives it no Carnegie basic classification in 2019 and 2020 (C18BASIC -2, not applicable), so the Carnegie rule cannot find it in those years; from 2021 its classification is Special Focus Research Institution (C21BASIC 27), which the rule leaves out. Its campus holds research and clinical facilities whose staff and researchers are not in its FTE. So a rate per student would not measure its campus population. It is left out of rate rankings; its counts are shown. Source: IPEDS institutional characteristics (HD2019 to HD2021, C18BASIC and C21BASIC), https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/DataFiles.aspx
